## Safety and release checklist

- [ ] Existing business data, configuration, uploads and backups are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets or personal information are included.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Migration, startup, update and rollback risks are documented where applicable.
- [ ] Commercial activation remains subject to owner approval.
